transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 922 Kassikay Drive?
Yes, this is 922 Kassikay Drive. I’m here with two people. No water inside. I can help with a boat.
Thanks for confirming your address and offering to help with a boat. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Two people are here. No one can’t come to the phone.

Got it, two people here, no one can’t come to the phone. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave on their own. No wheelchair or medical needs here.
Understood, no one is unable to leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. I can help with a boat.
Thanks for the update and offer of help. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
I don’t have a truck or boat, but I can help neighbors get a ride out if they need one.
Thanks for offering to help neighbors get a ride out. Let me read that back: 2 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes, that’s right. Two people, no water inside yet.
Acknowledged, two people, no water inside yet. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
